title: Halloumi quinoa bowl
summary: Halloumi quinoa bowl is a mediterranean dinner built around halloumi and quinoa, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat halloumi dry and season it. Prep quinoa and canned chickpeas in water for Halloumi quinoa bowl so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook halloumi on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook quinoa and canned chickpeas in water in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Halloumi quinoa bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice halloumi and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the quinoa, simmered in salted water until tender.
